about: Lawful public sources Move forward's monitoring layer reads (fdcore.monitor). Each is read through its public pages as a person would read them: no sign-in, no VPN, no hidden identity, no household data. Terms were read on 22 October 2026. Standing grades are the source's reliability on the six-by-six scale (A to F); the officer who accepts an item sets its grade.

sources.name: Homelessness statistics
sources.publisher: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government
sources.terms_note: Open Government Licence v3.0, except where otherwise stated (GOV.UK terms and conditions)
sources.watch_for: Quarterly statutory homelessness releases, their announcements and revisions; the live tables.

sources.name: Homelessness code of guidance for local authorities
sources.publisher: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government
sources.terms_note: Open Government Licence v3.0, except where otherwise stated (GOV.UK terms and conditions)
sources.watch_for: A chapter's Updated date and its change notes (the page's history, or GOV.UK's content API for the same path), above all chapters 15, 17 and 22, which the planner's checks cite.

sources.name: legislation.gov.uk
sources.terms_note: Open Government Licence v3.0 except where otherwise stated; Crown and database right
sources.watch_for: New statutory instruments and amendments touching Part 7 of the Housing Act 1996, the suitability orders (SI 2003/3326, SI 2012/2601), the review regulations (SI 2018/223) and commencement of the Renters' Rights Act 2025.

sources.name: Ombudsman decisions: homelessness
sources.publisher: Local Government and Social Care Ombudsman
sources.terms_note: Not the Open Government Licence. The Ombudsman's copyright page: "You may re-use the information on this website free of charge in any format"; "you must acknowledge the source and our copyright in cases where you supply the information to others"; "you must reproduce the information accurately, without amendment"; "you must not use the information in a misleading way"; "you must not use the information for the principal purpose of advertising or promoting a particular product or service". So these items stay off anything used to promote a service. Summaries here are this planner's own words; the passage quoted is unchanged. Copyright: Local Government and Social Care Ombudsman.
sources.watch_for: Published decisions on temporary accommodation: suitability, bed and breakfast past six weeks, delays in reviews, out-of-area placements. Summaries never name the council or anyone else.
